labelPolicy: BLIND REVIEW. The pack carries no model labels. Model labels (annotator A = claude-opus-5-5, author of the pipeline; annotator B = a blind model annotator of the same family) stay in golden-v1.json / golden-v1.annotator-b.json, labelled as model labels. Human labels are stored separately (golden-v1.human-labels.json) with the reviewer’s name and native language; calibration is claimed only against human labels.

grammar.question: Is the sentence grammatical and morphologically correct (particles, classifiers / measure words, verb forms, word order)?

naturalness.question: Would a native speaker plausibly say this, in this situation? marginal = understandable but odd or stilted.
naturalness.clarification: Judge the wording only (would a native speaker say it like this in this situation?). Meaning problems across turns go to coherence.

targetUsage.question: Is the TARGET word present and used in its intended sense and a correct form?

cue.question: If a learner followed the cue / English, would they produce this sentence (same meaning)? n/a when no cue is given.

qa.question: For a question→reply exchange: does the reply answer the question asked (right type: time for "when", reason for "why", amount for "how much")?

coherence.question: Do the turns make sense together as a conversation (logic, facts, chronology)? n/a for a single sentence.
coherence.clarification: Judge MEANING across the turns: does the reply connect to what was said AND does the exchange make sense (logic, facts, time)? A reply of the right form with absurd content ("Is the money big?" — "Very big.") is INCOHERENT. Phrasing alone belongs to naturalness.

register.question: Are politeness, speech level and speaker-gendered forms right for the stated speaker and relationship?

usefulness.question: Would this teach the target word well to a learner at this level (a real, reusable communicative use)?
usefulness.clarification: useful = a real, reusable way to use this word that a beginner needs · weak = correct but artificial, rare or low-value · not-useful = teaches something wrong, meaningless or misleading.

errorCategories.GRAMMAR_MORPHOLOGY: wrong particle / inflection / 的-得 / verb form
errorCategories.MISSING_ARGUMENT: a required object / complement / verb is missing (e.g. 跟 with no object, 想 + 可以 with no verb)
errorCategories.SELECTIONAL_MISMATCH: words that cannot combine in meaning (money "big", milk "funny", a movie you "want" as 欲しい)
errorCategories.WRONG_SENSE: the target is used in a sense other than the intended one
errorCategories.TENSE_ASPECT_CONFLICT: time reference conflicts with mood / aspect (let's go … yesterday; もう … 買わなかった)
errorCategories.QA_TYPE_MISMATCH: the reply gives the wrong type of answer (a day for "what time")
errorCategories.NON_ANSWER: the reply does not answer the question at all
errorCategories.CUE_MISMATCH: cue / English does not lead to this sentence
errorCategories.REGISTER_GENDER_PARTICLE: a speaker uses the other gender's particle / pronoun
errorCategories.REGISTER_POLITENESS: wrong politeness / speech level for the relationship
errorCategories.TEMPLATE_FRAGMENT: a mechanical template / fragment nobody would say alone
errorCategories.UNIDIOMATIC: grammatical but not how it is said
errorCategories.REDUNDANT_DUPLICATE: repeats another item's construction with no new function
